claim.claim-text: a biaxially-oriented polypropylene base; and an aluminum oxide thin film formed on one surface of the biaxially-oriented polypropylene base, wherein: the biaxially-oriented polypropylene base has a plane orientation factor ΔP ranging from 0.005 to 0.020 according to phase-contrast measurement, the aluminum oxide thin film shows a ratio of oxygen and aluminum (O/Al) ranging from 1.0 to 1.5 as calculated by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, wherein the biaxially-oriented polypropylene base is provided, on the one surface thereof, with a primer-treated layer formed by discharge treatment.
2. The gas barrier laminate according to claim 1, wherein the discharge treatment is reactive ion etching treatment.
3. A method for producing a gas barrier laminate comprising:
4. The method for producing a gas barrier laminate according to claim 3, wherein the discharge treatment is reactive ion etching treatment.
